entries.454d14e49b1446de: A feature is one-stop support for both brokerage and management operations, with products and services exchanging data with one another. The company handles everything in-house from product planning and development through sales, implementation support, customer success and support, and has built a structure providing community-based support from locations nationwide. As a result, the churn rate for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was low at 0.5%, and recurring revenue centered on monthly usage fees forms its earnings base. entries.e0a6d8df788f8f81: This is a group of cloud-based business support services covering the entire rental property management business. Centered on the core system 'Chintai Kakumei', the company provides 'Management Analysis Option', a communication app for tenants and owners 'Kurasapo Connect', 'Owner Proposal AI Robo Ⅱ', which automatically generates proposal reports, and 'ＡＩ－ＯＣＲ storage service' 'ＡＩ Ｋａｍｉｇａｋａｒｉ'. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,356 million.
entries.e7ed34de1d9ddcc0: The company's medium-term vision is 'Creating an innovative platform in the real estate field through technology,' and its basic management policies include providing one-stop real estate business support services and consistent service from in-house development through after-sales support. It positions the coming period as a 'growth promotion phase' and states that it will promote expanding the share of Riapro ＢＢ＋ and Chintai Kakumei 11, supporting customer acquisition for brokerage companies, and strengthening AI-based development and products. It places expansion of monthly recurring revenue in both Management Solution and Brokerage Solution at the core of its growth strategy, and states that it aims to cross-sell paid services to the customer base built through free services and raise average revenue per customer through the use of AI and data. In the medium to long term, it also states that it will advance into areas expected to create synergies with existing businesses, such as the ｔｏＣ area, vacancy countermeasures using AI, and maximizing owners' asset value.
